input.quote: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments.
input.rationale: Section 3.4(b) conditions our convenience-termination right on paying "early termination charges" of unspecified amount, set out in Attachment A and Service Option Attachments (which IBM may unilaterally amend under Section 13.1). That is a liquidated amount payable by the Customer with no cap, contrary to the preferred position of no liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer; Section 3.3 confirms these charges are otherwise payable except where IBM has breached. No Customer-payable liquidated damages appear elsewhere (Section 4.2 refers only to late payment fees, and Section 9.2 caps Customer liability to actual direct damages). We proposed deleting the charge, with a fallback cap of three months' recurring charges if an early-termination fee is unavoidable.

proposal.summary: Remove uncapped Customer-payable early termination charges in Section 3.4(b)
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have removed the open-ended early termination charges payable by us on convenience termination, since our playbook does not permit liquidated damages or penalties payable by the Customer, particularly where the amount sits in Attachment A that IBM may change unilaterally under Section 13.1. If an early termination charge is essential, we can accept one capped at three months' recurring charges for the terminated Services as the sole such amount.

ops.oldText: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments.
ops.newText: b. paying all charges accrued for Services performed through the effective date of termination. Customer will not be liable for any early termination charge, penalty, liquidated damages, or other minimum or unearned amount in respect of such termination.
